notes: Most ids are text keys made by the application (ACTIVITY.ACT_ID is a number); links between tables ("references") are kept by the application, not by foreign key constraints.
Every table with SYSDTE stamps the last change time.
Times ending in _UTC (and STAFF.LAST_LOGIN) are UTC; other date-time values are hospital local time.

tables.description: Hospital settings as key/value pairs (name, contact, hours, booking, boarding, reminder, billing and website options). Edited in Settings.
Staff roles (Manager, Office staff, Vet, Technician, Groomer, Website editor).
Admin menu pages grouped into sections, with the rights each page offers and the name of its extra right.
Default rights of each role on each menu page.
People who sign in to the admin, plus their website profile for vets, technicians and groomers.
Rights of one person on one menu page.
Species each vet, technician or groomer sees.
Weekly working hours of a person, one row per weekday.
Planned time off of a person.
Signed-in sessions (8 hours, renewed while working).
Activity log: who did what and when, including refused actions and failed sign-ins.
Kinds of animals the hospital sees.
Breed suggestions per species.
Room types: exam, special, emergency, surgery, recovery, grooming and boarding runs.
Rooms, tables and boarding runs.
Teams that group booking types on the website.
Price list: practice, medicine, test, vaccine, grooming, boarding, product and fee items.
Result fields of a test item with units and normal ranges (optionally per species).
What can be booked (online or by staff): visit type, length, species, price item and drop-off rules.
People who do each booking type.
Days the hospital is closed.
Pet owners.
Pets and their owner.
Weight history of a pet.
Vaccines given to a pet and when the next one is due.
Bookings: clinic, grooming and surgery visits and boarding stays, from the website, phone or desk.
History of each appointment (booked, confirmed, checked in, moved, cancelled, ...).
A visit or boarding stay in the hospital, from check-in to closed.
Which room a visit was in, from when to when, and with whom.
Medical notes of a visit (SOAP fields and vitals), signing and addenda.
Diagnoses recorded on a visit.
Orders on a visit: treatments, medicines, tests, vaccines, grooming, boarding nights and extras, products and fees.
Test results, one row per result field, with the normal range and flag at the time.
Files added to a visit (stored in the vault folder).
One invoice per visit, with totals, payments and balance.
Lines of an invoice, copied from the visit orders or added at checkout.
Payments taken on invoices.
Every email attempt to an owner (visit summary, invoice, statement, booking) and its result.
Contact log for due reminders (vaccines, rechecks, wellness).
Content blocks of each public page.
Earlier versions of page content.
Media library: photos, videos and PDFs.
Photo albums shown on the Media page.
Pictures in an album, in order.
Messages sent from the website contact form.
Yearly number counters for visit, invoice, payment and client numbers.
